geography: Worldwide (Incyte's net product revenue line; U.S., Europe, Japan)
moa: Fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR1/2/3) kinase inhibitor

launch_evidence.quote: We began capitalizing PEMAZYRE inventory after FDA approval in April 2020 as the related costs were expected to be recoverable through the commercialization of the product.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2020Q2, the quarter of FDA approval (April 17, 2020) and first sales: the 2020Q2 release prints 'Pemazyre net product revenue' of 3,786 thousand with a nil prior-year column, and the 2020Q3 release attributes revenue growth partly to 'the launch of Pemazyre'.
search_log: Listed every filing of Incyte (CIK 879169) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks with item 2.02 (2020-07 to 2026-11) and every 10-Q/10-K; parsed every table row.

Rows: 'Pemazyre net product revenue(s)' (to 2021Q3) / 'Pemazyre' of the net product revenues table in each quarter's own earnings release, three-month column; the second 'Pemazyre' row from 2023 sits in the royalty/milestone section and is not used.

Checks: the 2020Q4 release prints 2020 Pemazyre 25,884 = 3,786 + 8,089 + 14,009; later Q4 releases print full-year figures equal to the sum of the quarters (e.g. 2025: 18,440 + 22,192 + 22,741 + 23,354 = 86,727).
